subject: Action: SRE assignment prompt, submission window, and reviewer routing
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@gmail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, HireCo Recruiting <talent@hireco.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SRE take-home prompt and submission details

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for taking the time to interview for the Senior SRE role. As discussed, attached is the take-home spec we’d like you to complete. High-level items:

- Deliverable: short design doc (max 3 pages) + a small script or pseudo-code showing the automated remediation logic.
- Format: PDF for doc, .py or .md for code. If you prefer a single zip, that’s fine.
- Deadline: preferred submission by 11:59PM PT on Mon Mar 2, 2026. If you need a short extension, let us know — we can be flexible to a degree.
- Review cadence: internal reviewers will review between Mar 3–5 and provide debrief notes by Mar 6.

I’ve attached the SRE-takehome-spec.pdf and a plain-text instruction file. There’s also a Drive folder with a minimal template: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSRE-samira

Please reply to confirm you received this and whether the deadline works. If you have any clarifying questions, ask here and I’ll loop in the hiring manager.

Best,
Dev Patel
Technical Recruiter (Interim)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SRE-takehome-spec.pdf (4 pages)

Thanks — I received the files. Quick clarifications: 1) For the small script, is pseudocode acceptable (I don’t want to attach production code for IP reasons), and 2) is the time zone for the deadline PST/PDT or should I assume UTC?

Also, do you have a preferred filename pattern?

Thanks,
Samira

Samira —

Pseudocode is totally fine; we’re evaluating approach, trade-offs, and clarity rather than production-ready repo code. Deadline is 11:59PM PT (Pacific Time) on Mar 2.

Filename: surname_firstname_role_date (e.g., Khan_Samira_SRE_20260302.zip) — helps us keep files organized.

Monica and I will be reviewers. Monica will handle the systems design rubric; I’ll focus on operational playbooks and tone.

Looking forward to reading this.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Engineering Manager, SRE
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick q’s, Samira. Confirming: pseudocode is fine and deadline is 11:59PM PT on Mar 2. Filename convention Lauren suggested is ideal.

I also dropped a lightweight template into the Drive folder (see link above) with example headings for the doc. If you prefer to upload to your own Dropbox/Drive, send a link and I’ll pull it into the review folder.

If anything changes on our side (reviewer availability or timeline) I’ll update the thread. Good luck — and don’t hesitate to ping if you need anything.

Best,
Dev
